_A_lshock_extreme: Liquidation fade at the extreme end of the dose-response found in exploration. Frozen: lshock z=8, m=5, e=1.0, long, taker entry, hold 60, 50% per trade, <= 2 open (primary); z=6 the same (reference). Universe: the 52 names of data.BN_SYMBOLS not used so far (EOS XTZ ALGO THETA ICP CRV SNX COMP MKR LDO RUNE DYDX GALA CHZ ENJ 1INCH SUSHI YFI ZEC XMR KAVA ZIL EGLD HBAR VET GRT FLOW NEO WAVES DASH IOTA ONE KSM CELO RSR BAL ALPHA LRC STORJ SKL OCEAN ANKR BAND HYPE TIA SEI WLD 1000PEPE WIF ENA JUP TAO ORDI), 1-min bars 2021-01..2026-10, in blocks of 10 coins. CONFIRMED only if, for z=8 pooled: net per trade > 0; t on daily sums > 2; positive in 2021-23 AND in 2024-26; still positive without the three best days; days with 1-2 triggers positive. Also reported: the 10 original coins in 2024-26 and the 20 replication coins (their z=6 trades were seen in the first pass, so they are supporting evidence only).
_B_us_session_momentum: R24 (trends that leave the New York kill zone persist), found as the opposite of the single-print rule. Event: a coin's move over the US session 13:30-19:15 UTC is >= +1.5% (log). Measure: its return over the next 72 h from 19:15, minus that coin's mean 72 h return from 19:15 over all days of the sample (so a bull market does not count). Samples: (i) the 10 original coins 2024-01..2026-10; (ii) the 20 replication coins 2021-01..2026-10. CONFIRMED only if the excess is > 0 with day-clustered t > 2 in BOTH samples. Reported, not required: the variant that also closed above a session single-print band, the 24 h horizon, down-moves (expected: nothing).
_C_single_print_bounce: R16 'mechanical bounce after the fill'. Event: the far edge of a session single-print band (>= 30 bp, is2_profile definition) is reached within 24 h of the session's close. Measure: 30-minute return away from the band, real bands vs placebo bands (geometry of the same session 8 days earlier). Samples as in B. CONFIRMED only if real exceeds placebo by >= 5 bp with day-clustered t > 2 in both samples. Even then it is below a taker round trip: its use would be order timing for the slow books, not a book.
_D_one_voiced_breakout: Trade-size buckets as continuation (the opposite of R3). Event: a 5-minute bar closing within 0.2% of the 1-day high on which every size bucket's delta/volume is more than 1 sd above its own previous 7 days (>= 3 buckets with >= 2% of the bar's volume). Measure: 4 h forward return vs all other bars at the 1-day high. Sample: BTC, ETH, SOL 2024-01..2026-10. CONFIRMED only if the difference is > 0 with t > 2 (daily means). Reported: the same on 1 h and 24 h, and the mirror at 1-day lows.
_E_capitulation_at_source: R1 on the author's kind of venue and era: Bybit inverse BTCUSD 2019-10..2022-12, orders merged by timestamp (is2_bybit). Not a confirmation sample but the last untested angle: if 'every bucket net negative' (his literal rule) and its abnormal-flow versions show no excess forward return over 1, 3 and 5 days there either, R1 is recorded DEAD: five formulations on Binance plus the source venue, reason = one-voiced flow continues; his three examples were large down days. If it does show an excess there (t > 2) and not on Binance, R1 stays OPEN as venue-specific and waits for the Hyperliquid `tsz` data.
